headline: Fate of Indonesian Stock Market Status Not Yet Final, OJK Brings Good News from MSCI
summary: Indonesia's financial services regulator OJK said global rating bodies recognised reforms at the Indonesian stock exchange. MSCI and FTSE hold differing views on the exchange's market status, which has not been finalised.
why: MSCI and FTSE Russell are global index providers whose classification of a market determines how much passive fund capital flows into its stocks.
original_headline: Nasib Status Bursa RI Belum Final, OJK Bawa Kabar Baik dari MSCI
